LIST-MEMBERS.summary: Lists all members in the cluster with their metadata.
LIST-MEMBERS.complexity: O(M) where M is the number of members.

reply_schema.description: The members of the cluster, keyed by member id.

process_id.description: Base32-hex encoded Versionstamp, unique per process lifetime.

external_advertise.description: Addresses clients connect to, host:port, preferred entry first.

internal_advertise.description: Addresses other cluster members connect to, host:port, preferred entry first.

latest_heartbeat.description: Monotonically increasing heartbeat counter. 0 if no heartbeat has been recorded yet.
